_meta.notes: Rolling 90-day conflict events and fatalities per country, from ACLED via the OCHA HDX HAPI conflict-events endpoint (start_date=2026-07-16). Buckets are calendar-monthly and the newest month is IN PROGRESS, so its counts will rise on the next refresh; the window is the calendar months overlapping the last 90 days, not an exact 90-day slice. Admin levels partition the world — admin2 24 countries, admin0 218 countries, total 242 — and per country only the finest level with rows is counted, never summed across levels. intensity_score = min(100, 25*log10(1+fatalities_90d)); 100 at 10,000 fatalities/90d. is_live=true: this is a current-quarter observation, not an annual index. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED); acleddata.com, redistributed by OCHA HDX under ACLED terms.
